page.overview:
Who is Daisy?

Daisy was a small domestic dog living in Calgary, Canada. In 2022, a young Nasutoceratops found itself on the porch of Daisy's home, much to the curiosity of Daisy and her owner.

Daisy appears in a video on the viral marketing website Dinotracker.com. In the clip, we see Daisy standing at a glass door of her home, barking at something outside on the porch. As Daisy's owner questions what the thing triggering Daisy is, she tells Daisy to stop barking. As Daisy watches on, wagging her tail, Daisy's owner turns on the porch light, revealing a young Nasutoceratops standing outside. Daisy is scared away as the owner makes a comment about the animal's young age.
